newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-PAKISTAN DROP SOHAIL FOR SECOND ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN DROP SOHAIL FOR SECOND ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Pakistan selectors dropped Aamir Sohail on Wednesday for the second one-day international against Zimbabwe in Lahore.
He lost his place despite playing a leading role with former captain Salim Malik in helping Pakistan secure a three-wicket win and a 1-0 lead in the three-match series.
Sohail hit four fours and a six in his innings of 55 and combined with Malik in a 53-run fourth-wicket stand.
The selectors picked 18-year-old Lahore fast bowler Abdul Razzak in place of Sohail for Friday's match.
Fast bowler Waqar Younis, rested for the first game in the one-day series, has not returned to the squad.
Team (from): Wasim Akram (captain), Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Ijaz Ahmad, Salim Malik, Hasan Raza, Azam Khan, Moin Khan, Azhar Mahmood, Saqlain Mushtaq, Shahid Nazir, Abdul Razzak.
